doc.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: NEA Jazz Master, family and the future
title: Looking ahead: the Beirut engagement and missing bombings by a day
summary: Walton says he is thrilled to be asked to Beirut for solo sets, jokes about narrowly missing bombings in Israel, and Brower admits he is skittish.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: It's sort of like what's left for you?
What you do is sufficient unto itself. Obviously, people enjoy [being?] busy.
Yes, especially if you don't do it too much. [inaudible-overlapping voices]
But what else is on your horizon?

Uh, yeah, uh, just uh enough of myself, you know, I'm just uh uh, if I got lucky enough to hand down something, I'm proud to do that but uh I'm quite thrilled that uh somebody as far away as Beirut would want me. But even, even I'm gonna play alone, I'm not takin' this group, mind you. Just gonna go there and play it alone uh, two one-hour sets, three nights and uh I, I can't wait to … Those kind of challenges uh excite me. I say, "What the hell am I gonna do?" I mean, I gotta sit down and I gotta play, but uh, who are these … What kind of people are the Lebanese people? Uh …
So yeah, I saw a [C?] on the uh …
Yeah, the computer showed me that, the way it looks.

Yeah. Well uh, we'll have to see can I survive that uh. Very often I miss the bombings by one day. I was in uh Israel and uh we landed in Tel Aviv, and uh we uh went uh to Jerusalem to play in a big library. This was a trio. And uh the uh promoter was a piano player so I was lucky. He, he liked me. And so, and then we went back and when we left Jerusalem, the next day we read about a bombing, and then we played in Tel Aviv that next night in a big hall and it was magnificent. And we flew back to America and on the newspaper, bombing in Tel Aviv. So we, I have uh, uh, uh a reputation, so to speak, of missing them by one day. But of course I didn't stay in that place uh three days like I [will be?] in this one, like I play it like uh like, like the uh, the game plan is to stay in this place three whole days, so I'm uh … You'll be the first one I call when I land back on these shores with uh, with a thanks for your reassuring uh, uh and convincing uh warning uh … if there, if there's such a thing as reassuring, convincing …
Just because I’m skittish doesn't mean you have to be.
Oh, okay, well thank you for that uh … I'll take along with me.
I’ll admit it man, I’m a ninny.
